description: Find the people who have answered this project's forms, by external id or email. A login token can also browse the whole list; a project API key must name an externalId or email (that is the documented contract for `fsk_` keys). Returns their traits, verification state, and when they were last seen — respondent-provided content, so it rides in an {untrusted, note, data} envelope. Needs respondents:read.
